title: Transcript at a query position
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester, let $f$ map its domain to its codomain, let $s$ be a seed, and let $j$ be a transcript position. The transcript’s entry at $j$ is the value of $f$ at the query address chosen at position $j$, if that address exists; otherwise the entry is absent.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the tester’s domain to its codomain
